updates.title: Accounts, Steam sign-in and the new site
updates.summary: Sign in with Steam, make a launcher key, and see the leaderboard on the new website.
body: The CodLegacy website now has real accounts. You sign in with Steam: we only learn your Steam ID, never your password.

After signing in you can make a 32-character launcher key on your account page. The launcher will use it to get a one-minute join ticket, and game servers confirm that ticket with the account service. Servers never see your key.
The launcher program itself is still in development, so there is no download yet. The store, wallet and Battle Pass pages are placeholders: nothing is for sale and nothing will be.
